verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Dropbox serves an llms.txt file (HTTP 200) with a short product description, so an agent can be pointed at it. However, the content is thin (a marketing blurb, not structured agent-oriented documentation), and other agent-doc formats (docs.md, OpenAPI) return 404, suggesting no broader agent-native documentation strategy. Missing for 10: richer/structured llms.txt content covering API capabilities, machine-readable docs (docs.md/OpenAPI) actually resolving, and independent confirmation that agents successfully consume it.
